subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should allowed elevated sessions with no explicit `elevatedDefault` keep sandbox exec as the default, or should the current elevated-by-default host exec contract remain supported?
rationale: The requested change crosses the sandbox escape boundary and can alter existing operator workflows, so automation should not choose the default/security contract.

options.title: Default Elevated Off
options.body: Unset `elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, while `/elevated on|ask|full` and explicit elevated requests remain the deliberate ways to leave the sandbox.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Preserve current docs and runtime behavior where allowed elevated sessions default to host exec and `ask` is an approval-gated alias of `on`.

options.title: Add Separate Opt-In Mode
options.body: Keep current `on` and `ask` semantics but add a distinct sandbox-by-default mode for per-call elevated host exec.

recommendation.title: Default Elevated Off
recommendation.body: Unset `elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, while `/elevated on|ask|full` and explicit elevated requests remain the deliberate ways to leave the sandbox.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the exec runtime, auto-reply directive default, and elevated docs surfaces that need to be aligned.
